subject: Upstage: slate rollout ops and term tweak request
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@upstage.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@upstage.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — add 3 engineering squads, and question on term amendment

Hi Priya,

Quick note from the product org — we're ready to bring three additional engineering squads onto Redwood for the next quarter (Search, Recommendations, Integrations). Can you confirm: 1) how many additional API keys / namespaces we should request for per-squad isolation, and 2) whether we can adjust our committed throughput upward without re-signing a full multi-year contract?

We'd like to stagger activation across July/August and would prefer a short-term term amendment (12-month addendum) rather than a full renewal conversation right now.

Attaching a rough list of apps and expected monthly token volumes. Can we get a proposed ops+commercial plan by EOD Wednesday?

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Park
Head of Product Operations — Upstage Labs
anna@upstage.com

Attachment: upstage_expansion_capacity_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet — app names, squads, monthly token estimates)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@upstage.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 engineering squads, and question on term amendment

Hi Anna — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. Happy to run ops+commercial together. Short answers up front:
- API keys: recommended 1 key per squad + 1 shared key for infra (so 4 keys total). If you need strict isolation per app within squads we can issue additional namespaces, but that adds bookkeeping.
- Throughput: we can increase committed capacity for an interim 12-month addendum; we typically do a committed monthly token uplift with a pro-rated charge and a one-line addendum (no full contract re-sign).

Plan I'm proposing (will formalize in the attached addendum):
1) Week of Jul 9 — provision keys and sandbox routes for Search and Recommendations (proof-of-traffic).
2) Jul 23 — enable Integrations, cutover of 2 squads to dedicated routes.
3) Aug 6 — finalize routing policies and apply KV cache profiles to keep effective latency within SLOs.

I've looped in Monica for the technical provisioning timeline and Laura for the commercial addendum and pricing. Monica — can you review capacity notes and confirm the KV/cache recommendations for the Search workload?

Laura — I'll send a one-page addendum draft that covers the uplift, price pro-ration, and renewal trigger (12 months).

Best,
Priya
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Anna Park <anna@upstage.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add 3 engineering squads, and question on term amendment

Anna / Priya — quick tech notes after reviewing the attached volume estimates:
- Search: expected token spike at index builds; recommend enabling burst capacity for Search namespace and a 2x prefix KV cache TTL for embeddings-heavy requests.
- Recommendations: moderate tokens but high concurrent requests — suggest a dedicated pod with continuous batching set to 64ms aggregation and 32-request max batch.
- Integrations: latency-sensitive webhooks — route through our low-latency region and pin to smaller sequence-length-optimized kernels.

Key provisioning: we can pre-generate 4 keys as Priya suggested and stage them in the console with role tags (dev/stage/prod). We'll provide a provisioning runbook for your SREs.

Attachments: none in this message.

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@upstage.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — commercial draft attached

Hi Anna — attaching the proposed term addendum (proposed_term_addendum_v1.pdf) in this thread and a short pricing summary inline: 
- Current committed tier: 18M tokens/mo (base)
- Proposed uplift: +9M tokens/mo for the 12-month addendum (total committed 27M tokens/mo)
- Price treatment: uplift at current committed rate for first 6 months, then 85% of committed rate months 7–12 (to encourage adoption).
- Pro-ration: uplift charges start from activation date of each squad.

If this looks reasonable I'll prepare a DocuSign addendum. One question for you: do you want the addendum to explicitly preserve the existing SLA/penalty terms or to apply the Dedicated-tier SLA only to the uplifted capacity? We can do either; dedicated SLA applied to uplifted capacity is less risky commercially for Redwood but may matter to your compliance team.

Next steps: Anna confirms SLA preference and activation dates (Search, Recommendations, Integrations). We'll then finalize DocuSign and Monica will start provisioning keys.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Renewal Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_term_addendum_v1.pdf (addendum draft — uplift quantity, pricing schedule, pro-ration rules)
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@upstage.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Jul 2028 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — confirmations

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation from our side:
- Activation plan accepted: Search (Jul 16), Recommendations (Jul 30), Integrations (Aug 13).
- We prefer the Dedicated-tier SLA to apply to the uplifted capacity (Search + Recommendations). Integrations can remain on the standard SLA for now.
- Please proceed with issuing 4 keys and the provisioning runbook; we'll distribute to our SREs and schedule a 45-min handoff call next week.

Anna and I reviewed pricing; DocuSign when ready.

—Daniel
